project.name: SylphxAI Codec
project.summary: TypeScript/Bun monorepo for universal media codec, image-processing, and conversion packages, with optional WASM acceleration.
goals: Provide core media codec and conversion packages for image, video, animation, audio, metadata, drawing, filtering, transforms, compositing, and CLI usage.
Maintain pure TypeScript codec implementations with optional WASM acceleration where the repository explicitly provides it.
Track codec coverage, tests, and remaining media-format work through repo-local package code and progress documentation.
nonGoals: Own application-specific media workflows, storage products, CDN behavior, or user-facing media tools.
Own third-party codec patents, platform codec licensing, or external media-processing infrastructure.
Own enterprise engineering doctrine, standards, or project manifest schema.

owns.name: codec-package-monorepo
owns.description: The core, codecs, CLI, processing, metadata, text, and optional WASM packages under packages/.

owns.name: media-format-implementations
owns.description: Pure TypeScript media format decoders/encoders, tests, and progress tracking for supported image, video, animation, audio, and metadata formats.

doesNotOwn: Application-specific media workflows, media storage, CDN behavior, UI products, or production deployment policy.
Third-party codec patent/licensing decisions or external media-processing infrastructure.
Enterprise doctrine and manifest schema owned by SylphxAI/doctrine.

publicSurfaces.name: Processing packages
publicSurfaces.location: packages/transform, packages/color, packages/filter, packages/composite, packages/draw, packages/histogram, packages/metadata, packages/text

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema and engineering doctrine
Released GroundAtlas package/action for vendor-neutral project manifest validation and fleet dogfooding.

forbiddenCouplings: Do not encode a consuming product's media workflow, storage policy, or UI behavior into codec packages.
Do not imply patent/licensing clearance for complex media formats without a repo-owned decision and validation surface.
Do not fork doctrine standards into this repository.

delivery.deployPath: Pull requests and merge groups run .github/workflows/ci.yml with bun run validate, project-control boundary tests; main-branch Release workflow delegates to SylphxAI/.github reusable release workflow with caller-side id-token: write.
delivery.productionProof: bun run validate, CI evidence, package tests/builds, successful Release workflow for package changes, and package-registry readback for published versions.

packageRelease.releaseIntent: Changesets in .changeset/ declare version and changelog intent for codec workspace package releases.
packageRelease.versionPr: The release path must use a bot or GitHub App-owned Changesets version PR, with sylphx-release-bot as the default identity when installed.
packageRelease.publisher: Protected GitHub Actions release workflow publishes through OIDC/trusted publishing where supported, with any npm token kept as a bounded fallback.
packageRelease.publishProof: Successful Release workflow plus npm registry readback and provenance or attestation evidence for published codec package versions.

gaps.description: Complex codec and WASM support can involve external licensing and published-package recovery concerns; record runbooks before production lifecycle promotion.

Existing `bun run lint` / `biome check .` reports a broad pre-existing formatting and lint backlog across package source and Claude adapter files. The GroundAtlas CI gate uses build/test validation now and keeps lint cleanup as a separate package-quality slice instead of hiding it.
gaps.target: dedicated codec lint-baseline cleanup PR before making lint a required context

gaps.description: Existing all-workspace build (`bun run --filter * build`) is not yet green because optional WASM tooling and some mconv declaration-build configs are incomplete. The current CI gate preserves the existing release-critical root build while running all workspace tests.
gaps.target: dedicated mconv/WASM build-baseline cleanup before requiring all workspace builds
